title: Test Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Test Engineer with strong expertise in process automation, equipment integration, and data architecture to support complex manufacturing environments within the life sciences sector.

This role is critical in ensuring robust system integration, structured validation, and compliant operational support across GMP and non GMP environments. The position requires close collaboration with cross functional teams and international technology partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute end to end testing, validation, and change coordination for new equipment integrations and system enhancements
  • Perform on site testing activities to verify equipment connectivity, data integrity, and integration functionality
  • Support validation activities including technical batches, water runs, performance qualification runs, and operational GMP and non GMP cycles
  • Participate in and lead technical workshops focused on equipment and device integration topics
  • Conduct periodic IT and OT service performance reviews to ensure defined service levels are achieved
  • Contribute to design discussions within complex automation ecosystems in regulated manufacturing environments
  • Coordinate technical deliverables with external automation suppliers and system vendors
  • Create, review, and validate technical documentation ensuring traceability and compliance with established quality standards
  • Support adherence to GxP principles, CSV methodologies, and internal quality governance frameworks

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Biotechnology, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • 8 to 10 years of experience in process automation testing, system integration, or industrial automation environments
  • Mandatory proficiency in German and English
  • Hands on testing experience with at least one of the following technologies: Siemens PCS7, OSIsoft PI (Core and PIRaDS), Cytiva UNICORN
  • Experience within biopharmaceutical or advanced life sciences manufacturing
  • Strong understanding of GMP and non GMP systems, GxP requirements, and CSV methodologies
  • Experience working in Agile or Scrum delivery environments

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical thinking and structured problem solving capabilities within complex automation landscapes
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills across technical, business, and supplier stakeholders
  • Ability to operate effectively within Agile and SAFe environments
  • Capability to translate contractual or technical deliverables into well defined Agile user stories aligned with program cadence
  • Experience collaborating across global teams and managing supplier level technical interactions

title: Game QA Tester
description:
Why us?

At welevel, we are more than just a startup. We are a vibrant community of innovators passionate about crafting the future of RPG and survival games. Based in the heart of Munich, our team combines expertise in cutting-edge technologies with a love for gaming that fuels our creativity and ambition.

Here’s what makes us stand out:

  • Inspiring Work Environment: A central Munich location with a diverse, motivated, and international team that fosters creativity and collaboration.
  • Competitive Compensation: We believe in rewarding talent with attractive and fair packages.
  • Innovative Technology: Work with the latest tools and AI-driven workflows to push boundaries and make the impossible possible.

Your Role

As a Game QA Tester, you will actively contribute to the quality of our upcoming survival-to-city-builder RPG Solid River.

You will work hands-on with game builds throughout development, identifying bugs, inconsistencies and gameplay issues. This role comes with real impact: your findings directly influence priorities, fixes, and improvements in the game.

You don’t need extensive experience, what matters is passion for games, attention to detail, and the motivation to take ownership and grow within the role.

Responsibilities

  • Test game builds and features across different development stages
  • Identify, reproduce, and clearly describe bugs and unexpected behavior
  • Verify bug fixes and support regression testing
  • Create and maintain structured test cases for assigned areas
  • Participate in regular playtests and provide actionable gameplay feedback
  • Work closely with designers and programmers to clarify expected behavior
  • Support internal and external playtests, including preparation and follow-up
  • Take ownership of specific systems or test areas over time
  • Contribute to improving QA workflows, documentation, and tooling

Requirements

  • Strong passion for games, especially survival, building, and RPG games
  • Interest in complex gameplay systems, progression, and balance
  • High attention to detail and a structured way of working
  • Sense of responsibility for the quality of your work and the player experience
  • Ability to clearly describe issues and feedback in English (German is a plus)
  • Motivation to learn new tools, workflows, and game engines
  • Ability to work on-site in Munich and collaborate closely with the team

Nice to have, but not required:

  • First experience with game testing, playtesting, mods, or early-access games
  • Basic familiarity with Unreal Engine or other game engines

What We Offer

  • A hands-on QA role with real impact on the game
  • Responsibility from day one, with guidance and mentoring
  • A clear path to grow into more senior or lead QA responsibilities
  • Close collaboration with design, engineering, and production teams
  • A motivated and international team working on ambitious game systems
  • Modern tools and AI-powered workflows
  • An on-site role in our Munich office with a creative and open atmosphere
  • Competitive salary and long-term growth opportunities within the studio

About Us

welevel is a fast-growing AI-powered game studio in the heart of Munich. We're creating a blockbuster title with an ambitious team, blending industry veterans with next-gen tech. As the home for bold,

creative minds, welevel is where innovation meets imagination. Backed by top investors, we're on a mission to reshape the future of gaming.

description:
Cresta is on a mission to turn every customer conversation into a competitive advantage by unlocking the true potential of the contact center. Our platform combines the best of AI and human intelligence to help contact centers discover customer insights and behavioral best practices, automate conversations and inefficient processes, and empower every team member to work smarter and faster. Born from the prestigious Stanford AI lab, Cresta's co-founder and chairman is Sebastian Thrun, the genius behind Google X, Waymo, Udacity, and more. Our leadership also includes CEO, Ping Wu, the co-founder of Google Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platform.

We’ve assembled a world-class team of AI and ML experts, go-to-market leaders, and top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Greylock Partners, Sequoia, and former AT&T CEO John Donovan. Our valued customers include brands like Intuit, Cox Communications, Hilton, and Carmax and we’ve been recognized by Forbes and Bain Consulting as one of the top private AI companies in the world.

Join us on this thrilling journey to revolutionize the workforce with AI. The future of work is here, and it's at Cresta.

About The Role

We are seeking a diligent and detail-oriented Software Engineer in Test to join our engineering team in Berlin, Germany. This role will be crucial in ensuring the robustness, scalability, and high quality of our software solutions and will be highly focused on building, expanding, and maintaining our automated testing ecosystem. While strong manual testing instincts are important, this role is designed for someone who will spend the majority of their time writing code, advancing automation, and developing internal tools. The ideal candidate is someone who can independently identify what and how to test, take ownership of impactful projects, and help elevate quality across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing features.
  • Identify ambiguities or gaps in product specifications and propose improvements to ensure testability.
  • Automate key scenarios using our Playwright-based test framework (TypeScript), with a focus on reliability and maintainability.
  • Perform manual exploratory testing, particularly for complex, high-impact features or areas with low automation ROI.
  • Analyze and communicate test results, triaging issues with clear, actionable insights.
  • Maintain and evolve testing standards, procedures, and documentation.
  • Set up and manage testing environments to mirror production usage patterns.
  • Investigate customer-reported issues, including log analysis (e.g., from Datadog/Grafana), reproduction steps, and severity assessment.
  • Collaborate with developers and product managers to drive quality from feature design through release.
  • Contribute to release decisions with risk assessments and test coverage summaries.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to elevate quality across the SDLC.
  • Identify and advocate for opportunities to expand test coverage across the organization.

Qualifications

  • BS/MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in software QA within SaaS, preferably in customer engagement or contact center platforms.
  • Strong track record in creating and executing both manual and automated test strategies.
  • Proficiency in automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and modern development workflows.
  • Deep understanding of QA methodologies, processes, and CI/CD practices.
  • Attention to detail with a bias toward risk-based testing.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills, including backend and frontend issue investigation.
  • Ability to think like an end-user and test accordingly, especially when product requirements are minimal or evolving.
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to constructively advocate for quality.
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to testing infrastructure is a plus.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. Actual salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skills, and location, as well as applicable local minimum pay requirements. We are actively hiring for this role in Berlin. For further details, please consult your recruiter.

We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official Cresta employee, reach out to recruiting@cresta.ai

title: Software Test Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Wir von LACROIX sind davon überzeugt, dass Technologie zu einer unkomplizierteren, nachhaltigeren und sichereren Umwelt beitragen sollte. Dafür arbeiten wir seit mehr als 50 Jahren! Heute mit rund 4.300 Mitarbeiter*innen an 12 internationalen Standorten weltweit. Mit unseren 2 Geschäftsbereichen Electronics und Environment, erfüllen wir unseren Auftrag, um durch nützliche, robuste und sichere vernetzte Technologien zur Entwicklung nachhaltigerer Ökosysteme beizutragen.



Wir, die deutsche LACROIX SAE, gehören seit 2019 zum Geschäftsbereich Environment der LACROIX Group. Mit mehr als 50 Jahren Erfahrung sind wir in der Gruppe die Experten für innovative Fernwirk- und Stationsleittechnik für die Überwachung, Steuerung und Absicherung von elektrischen Netzen und Anlagen. Wir unterstützen Energieversorger – vom Weltkonzern bis zum Stadtwerk – dabei, die Herausforderungen der Energiewende und der Digitalisierung zu meistern.



Stellenbeschreibung

Wir entwickeln zukunftsweisende High-End-Informationstechnologien für Versorgungsunternehmen und Industrie. Unsere Lösungen kommen dort zum Einsatz, wo Qualität, Stabilität und Sicherheit kritisch sind – bei der Steuerung und dem Management komplexer Infrastrukturen und Anlagen.

Unsere Welt: Fernwirk- und Stationsleittechnik, Automatisierung und smarte Energielösungen.

Unsere Kund*innen: Energieversorger, Stadtwerke, Industrie – national und international.

Unser Spirit: regional verwurzelt, global vernetzt – als Teil der erfolgreichen LACROIX-Gruppe.

Intelligente Software ist das Herzstück unserer Produkte. Damit sie unter allen Bedingungen zuverlässig funktioniert, setzt unser Quality-Assurance-Team auf systematische Testabdeckung und einen hohen Automatisierungsgrad. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Dein Part

Als Software Test Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst du Verantwortung für die Qualität unserer Produkte. Dein Fokus liegt auf der konsequenten Erhöhung der Testabdeckung und der Weiterentwicklung unserer Test- und Automatisierungsstrategie – über verschiedene Technologien und Systemebenen hinweg.

Das erwartet Dich konkret:

  • Du entwickelst Strukturen und Methoden für unsere Testgebiete, indem du Softwarefunktionen systematisch analysierst und in Testfälle mit hoher Abdeckung überführst

  • Du unterstützt Entwickler*innen bei der Erstellung testbarer, klar strukturierter Softwareanforderungen

  • Du spezifizierst und implementierst automatisierte Testskripte auf Systemebene für PC-Applikationen und Embedded Software

  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst automatisierbare Testaufbauten aus Simulatoren, Verkabelung und Messgeräten

  • Du führst regelmäßige Regressionstests durch und stellst sicher, dass Funktionen auch nach Änderungen wie spezifiziert arbeiten

  • Du übernimmst systematische Fehleranalysen, grenzt Ursachen ein und leitest daraus neue Testszenarien ab



Qualifikationen

Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Studium der Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Praxiserfahrung (ca. 3–5 Jahre) als Software Tester*in, idealerweise im Umfeld Embedded Software

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Testgebieten und in der Analyse komplexer Fehlerzustände

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python, pytest, GitLab, Poetry

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Konzeption, Spezifikation, Implementierung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Softwaretests

  • Ausgeprägte analytische, konzeptionelle und methodische Fähigkeiten

  • Kundenorientiertes Denken und Qualitätsbewusstsein

Idealerweise bringst du außerdem Kenntnisse mit in:

  • Netzwerktechniken und -protokollen (z. B. Ethernet, DHCP, NTP, IPsec)

  • Kommunikationsstandards wie Modbus, IEC 60870-5, DNP3, IEC 61850

  • Agilen Entwicklungsmethoden

  • Atlassian-Tools (JIRA, Confluence)

  • Windows und Linux / WSL

  • Squash Test Management

  • ISTQB Foundation Level Zertifizierung



Zusätzliche Informationen

Warum Du zu uns kommen solltest

Weil Du bei uns nicht nur ein Rädchen im System bist. Du gestaltest mit, bekommst Raum für Deine Ideen und kannst wirklich etwas bewegen – in einem Umfeld, das Wert auf Offenheit, Entwicklung und Miteinander legt.

Warum es sich lohnt?

  • Stabilität trifft Zukunft: Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden, erfolgreichen Unternehmen mit einer wertschätzenden und offenen Unternehmenskultur.
  • Work-Life-Flexibility: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten – kombiniert mit einer attraktiven Vergütung, die sich lohnt. Plus 31 Tage Jahresurlaub.
  • Mehr als nur ein Gehalt: Profitiere von starken Benefits wie vermögenswirksamen Leistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge, JobRad-Leasing, Jobticket oder der Übernahme des M-Pakets von Urban Sports Club.
  • Teamspirit & Erlebnisse: Feiere mit uns Karneval, Sommer- und Weihnachtsfeste und power dich in der sportlichen Mittagspause beim Tischtennis oder Kickern aus oder bei deiner vom Arbeitgeber bezahlten M-Mitgliedschaft bei Urban Sports.
  • Stressfrei zur Arbeit: Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt vor Ort – weil dein Tag schon entspannt starten soll.

Das passt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung im PDF-Format – kurzes Motivationsschreiben und CV inklusive deines Gehaltswunsch – mit Angabe Deines möglichen Eintrittstermins und der Kennziffer -666 über den "Jetzt bewerben"-Button.

title: QA Engineer
description:
Your Responsibilities

As a QA Engineer at Assemblio, you are responsible for ensuring the quality, stability, and reliability of our SaaS platform. You design and execute testing strategies that guarantee our product meets the highest standards before reaching our customers. Together with a motivated, cross-functional team, you ensure that new features are not only innovative but also robust and production-ready.

You…

  • define and implement a comprehensive QA strategy focusing on reliability and performance.
  • design, develop, and maintain automated tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end tests).
  • execute manual and exploratory testing where automation is not applicable.
